scope: Independent reaggregation of published saved measurements; no new hardware performance or inference execution.

formulas.request_wall_rate: sum(output_token_count) / sum(elapsed_s); 16 * 128 generated tokens per arm
formulas.request_wall_time: elapsed_s is monotonic wall time around a native nonstream /completion HTTP call; excludes warmup and switching; does not measure Open WebUI rendering or per-token delivery
formulas.ttft: ttft_s = server prompt_ms/1000; this is a prompt-processing proxy, not observed streaming TTFT

hot14.scope: Two controls before one candidate; outputs differ in seven of eight cases; not balanced ABBA and not the same autoregressive work.

routing.scope: Whole pilot mixes free generation, fixed-prefix scoring, long/short counts and image; not per-case decode-only hit rate.

quality.scope: Same token prefixes do not freeze hidden activations, KV values or routing. Partial top100 distribution comparison and baseline self-replay, not general quality/PPL/KL/TVD.

limitations: Different exact prompts do not imply a representative independent workload distribution; several themes overlap (code/SQL/Japanese library fiction).
Eight purpose-written fresh prompts, each 128 tokens, are a local validation set, not long-context, long-conversation, concurrency or general quality coverage.
CPU plan ranks projection assignment counts; GPU plan ranks training count/native bytes. Neither objective directly minimizes critical-path layer latency.
The value/cost-weighted CPU plan was already tested once; its small difference is not independent proof of superiority.
No per-request routing sequence is stored in aggregate training census or whole-pilot H histogram. Joint expert co-occurrence and per-case routes cannot be reconstructed.

saved_input_usage.interpretation: Final ABBA is the first saved use of fresh inputs. Later poll/hybrid/hot and fixed-prefix evaluations reuse them, so they are no longer a new blind holdout for subsequent choices. This inventory cannot prove the absence of unrecorded prior use or generalization error.

analyzer_gate_probe.scope: Pinned analyzer on temporary copied receipts only; original saved runs remain complete and unchanged.
analyzer_gate_probe.observed_issue: Equal case lists are checked, but the lists are not matched to the expected frozen input manifest.
